secrets.name: TMDB_KEY
secrets.description: TMDb API key (https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api). Needed to fetch movie/TV metadata when media files are scanned into the library.

secrets.name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Spotify Web API client id (https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard). Needed to fetch album/artist/song metadata for music files.

secrets.name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Spotify Web API client secret from the same dashboard app as SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.
